difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a bounded above complex whose degree i term is pseudo-coherent with a degree shift is m-pseudo-coherent, and that a bounded above complex of pseudo-coherent modules is pseudo-coherent. The proof truncates the complex so that it becomes bounded, then inducts on the length of the complex using the cone lemma together with the stupid truncations, each degree shifted by its position being m-pseudo-coherent by hypothesis. The final statement follows because being m-pseudo-coherent for all m is equivalent to pseudo-coherence, and the first part supplies every m.
